subject: Weather + Settings
body:
- weather layer (screen-space, one draw item): rain with lightning flashes (Jungle, Pine Forest,
  Haunted Hollow), snow (Snowy Woods, Glacier Run), falling leaves (Autumn Valley), embers
  (Volcano), sparkles (Crystal Caves); Pyramid Desert stays clear
- Settings page from the garage: Music, Sound and Weather ON/OFF (saved)
